entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mohammad Sultan was an Afghan field hockey player who competed at the 1936 Summer Olympic Games held in Berlin, playing in both of his team's games. He was a member of the Durrani dynasty by marriage, holding the title of shahzada. Later in life, he became a superintendent of the Punjab Police.
